_comment: Per-cell n-wells whose body is on VDD, as boxes in the cell's own frame (um). Input to signoff/gen_erc_spec.py, which places them in ring coordinates for ties[].well_requires_boxes (ntap_vdd) / well_excludes_boxes (ntap_vddio) of signoff/erc-supply-spec.json.

Every other n-well in these cells is VDDIO-bodied. Provenance: the netlists in design/netlists/ (body node of each pfet) against the n-well polygons of the cell stream; per-well table in signoff/README.md.
vdd cell: the four clamp wells (core PFETs, body on VDD).
gpio cell: wells holding the 1.8 V logic PFETs (logic gates, level-shifter input inverters, receiver nand2/inv) and the receiver's VDD-bodied 5 V PFET (XMP4).
